findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects are not required to be encrypted at rest with a specified encryption mechanism.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving exported ledger data without enforced encryption at rest.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption, so stored model artifacts are not protected by an enforced encryption-at-rest policy.
The bucket lacks a default server-side encryption configuration, so runbook content can be stored without enforced encryption at rest.
